sources.title: BabyLM 4 at EMNLP 2026
sources.snippet: BabyLM 4 at EMNLP 2026: The tentative workshop schedule is now available. Posters from BabyLM 3 (2025) are available in the BabyLM 3 archive. Summary: BabyLM returns for its 4th year as both a shared task and a workshop at EMNLP 2026.

sources.title: GitHub - to1246zh-s-star/babylm-2026-multilingual · GitHub
sources.snippet: This repository contains the official implementation for our submission to the EMNLP 2026 BabyLM Challenge (Multilingual Track). We propose a Dual-Innovation architecture to tackle the strict 100M-token budget and parameter constraints.

sources.title: Baby
sources.snippet: Updated Rules for BabyLM Round 4 • New track: MultiLingual. Participants train on a MultiLingual mixture from BabyBabelLM. The challenge track focuses on English, Dutch, and Chinese, and allows a custom mixture totaling 100M tokens (with word counts adjusted by each language's Byte Premium in baseline construction).
